prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Ivera Frostwhistle. Character visual motifs: tall northern bow engineer wearing permafrost string gauges and layered ice-tuning plates; asymmetric longbow bearing vibrating crystal forks.
TOP LEFT: Overtone. Ability concept: landing a aimed shot temporarily tunes a visible location, maximum 2, each persisting 5 s. Shots do not globally slow.
TOP RIGHT: Tuning Shot. Ability concept: fires a narrow bolt that installs a crystal fork at its endpoint (terrain or ground); fork has 2 hit points. Can be fired through a champion for light damage, but ends behind them.
BOTTOM LEFT: Singing Ice. Ability concept: activates a frost vibration along the line between the two newest forks for 3 s. Enemies *crossing* the line suffer 28% slow for 1.1 s and take one burst; allies firing **parallel** to the line gain a small projectile-speed bonus.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Glass Rapture. Ability concept: resonates all active forks in a broad triangular sound field. Over 1.2 s the field forms three visible safe gaps; enemies still on the sounding lines take high damage and a 0.55 s stagger. Consumes forks.
